instalada.docstring:
F2.3 — conditional wiring of the finite passage to the curved field law.

The named H3 below is precisely the all-points, all-null-directions area/Clausius
condition required by AreaChart. It is NOT derived from the finite passage.
The arrow from the passage identity to H3 is an explicit input across different
types. Chart records, conservation, topology and smooth transitions are also
explicit inputs. The theorem asserts an implication, not a global solution.

cinco_limites: H3 is not derived from the state, Fundacao, or the light contract.
The identification of NamedAtlasH3 with Jacobson's H3 is [KNOWN], not a theorem here; the Lean name is a label.
No Lorentz wedge family is constructed. Its all-direction requirement is subsumed in the named H3 premise.
The recorded stress source is not linked to StressTensorData or MaxwellCertificate. Covariant conservation is an explicit record premise.
No metric or solution, local or global, is constructed.
